FAQ

Pricing questions, answered honestly.

What does the free trial actually include?

Full access to the Pro tier for 14 days. All connectors, all features, no feature gating. We'd rather you discover the real product is too expensive than the cheap product is too limited.

Do you charge per user, per workflow, or per integration?

Per active user, with generous workflow and storage limits at each tier. We don't meter integrations or charge per connector — that pricing model creates perverse incentives we'd rather avoid.

What counts as an "active user"?

A user account that took at least one action in the platform within the billing month. Read-only viewers and external collaborators (customers, suppliers, auditors with limited access) don't count toward your seat total.

Can we change plans mid-contract?

Upgrade any time, prorated. Downgrade at the end of your billing cycle. We don't lock customers into multi-year contracts to make this difficult — annual is the standard, monthly is available if you'd prefer.

What's included in implementation, and what's extra?

Pro plans include 16 hours of implementation services. Enterprise plans include a fixed-scope implementation (typically 4–8 weeks). Beyond that, we charge a published day rate — listed in the contract, not invented later.

Are there volume discounts?

Yes, for annual contracts above 100 users or multi-product deployments. Reach out and we'll send a written proposal. We don't do "make us an offer" pricing — you'll know exactly what you're paying.

Still not sure which plan fits?

Twenty minutes with our team and a few questions about your stack — we'll tell you which plan we'd recommend and why.
